How It Works

A little tavern. A very big sky.

Every commission asks for a thoughtful route. Its final ingredient shapes where it can connect on the Sky Chart, turning each small decision into part of a larger plan.

01 — COMMISSIONS

Choose your traveler

Read each request, then decide which commission deserves your limited ingredients.

02 — ROUTES

Arrange with intention

Build a two- or three-part route. The last ingredient becomes the route exit.

03 — SKY CHART

Create Phenomena

Match exits to create Phenomena, avoid Haze, and complete the day’s goals.

In-Game Screens

Find your way among the clouds.

Made for unhurried moments.

Mistralume has no combat and no countdowns. Take your time, follow the constellations, and make every route count.
